We built this for the counter, not the boardroom.

Stamp is a loyalty system for shopkeepers who know their customers by face but lose them to convenience.

principles

What we believe

Shopkeepers should own the relationship with their customers

Your data stays yours. We never contact your customers or sell their information.

If it needs a manual, it is too complicated

A shopkeeper should be able to set up and run the program without reading instructions.

Rewards must be fair to both sides

Customers earn something real. Shopkeepers control the cost. Nobody games the system.

We tell you what it cannot do yet

The product is new. We are honest about what is ready and what is coming.

pilot

How a pilot works

  1. 1

    We talk

    Tell us about your shop, your regulars, and what kind of reward makes sense.

  2. 2

    We set you up

    We create your program, configure your stamp card and scratch card prizes, and give you a QR to show.

  3. 3

    You go live

    Show the QR at your counter. We check in after a week to see how it is going.
